name: log-parse
title: Log Parse
description: Parses syslog (RFC 3164 / 5424) and common web server access logs into structured records.

usage.python:
from kura_rs import log_parse

for line in lines:
    record = log_parse.parse_line("rfc5424", line)
    print(record.host, record.message)
